IRS990.MissionDesc: San Diego Junior Theatre (Junior Theatre) was incorporated in 1948 as a nonprofit corporation and is the oldest youth theatre in the nation, offering affordable camps, classes, and outreach programs for children ages 3-18; as well as six main stage productions each season. Students gain confidence, learn leadership, practice teamwork, and build a skill set - not only for a theatre stage, but for the larger stage of the real world. Current students between ages 8 and 18 are invited to audition or work on the backstage crew for eight main stage productions. Productions include Broadway musicals, adaptations from the popular canon of children's literature, and Shakespeare, and are directed, choreographed, and designed by Junior Theatre's production staff and professional guest artists.San Diego Junior Theatre aims to create and sustain a community of inclusion, where everyone feels safe, welcomed and represented, regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, gender identit
IRS990.Desc: Educational programs and productions are made possible in part by show ticket sales, class and camp registrations, public contributions. Major funding is provided by the City of San Diego, the City of San Diego Commission for Arts and Culture and the San Diego Junior Theatre Auxiliary.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Junior Theatre originally began as a community program at San Diegos Old Globe Theatre. Today Junior Theatre operates as an independent, nonprofit organization for the benefit of children throughout San Diego County, and is the oldest youth theatre program in the country.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: JUNIOR THEATRE BELEIVES THAT IT HAS APPROPRIATE SUPPORT FOR ANY TAX POSITIONS TAKEN, AND AS SUCH, DOES NOT HAVE ANY UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT ARE MATERIAL TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: PRIOR TO FINALIZING THE CPA-PREPARED DRAFT OF FORM 990, THE COMPLETE DRAFT WITH ALL SUPPLEMENTAL SCHEDULES ARE PRESENTED TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, ALONG WITH THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT AUDIT REPORT, FOR REVIEW AND DISCUSSION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED NO LESS THAN ANNUALLY WITH STAFF AND BOARD MEMBERS, AT WHICH TIMES THEY ARE REMINDED OF THEIR ETHICAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES, AND ANY QUESTIONS OR ISSUES ARE DISCUSSED AND EVALUATED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15a
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE ORGANIZATION'S BYLAWS, AN EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE ASSESSES, EVALUATES, AND REVIEWS ANNUALLY THE APPROPRIATE SALARY AND OTHER COMPENSATION OF THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE IS COMPOSED OF CURRENT OFFICERS AND OTHER TRUSTEES SELECTED BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE BOARD. AS PART OF THIS PROCESS AN OUTSIDE CONSULTANT AT Newberry Williams was engaged for performance reviews and comp analysis.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SALARY FOR KEY EMPLOYEES IS DECIDED BY THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR BASED ON A PAYROLL BUDGET DISCUSSED IN THE FINANCE COMMITTEE AND APPROVED BY THE FULL BOARD OF TRUSTEES. AS PART OF THIS PROCESS AN OUTSIDE CONSULTANT AT Newberry Williams was engaged for performance reviews and comp analysis.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section C, Line 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE MADE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.
